cards.title: OpenAI Raises $11B at $1.25T Valuation
cards.body: OpenAI has secured an additional $11 billion in funding as part of an ongoing round expected to close in coming weeks. The raise values the company at $1.25 trillion, underscoring continued investor confidence in the AI leader.

cards.title: Meta Launches Spaces for Muse AI Collaboration
cards.body: Meta's Muse agents now feature Spaces, a new collaborative interaction tool for users. The addition expands how people can work with Meta's AI helpers.

cards.title: Crusoe Sells Wyoming Data Center to Google
cards.body: Crusoe Energy sold its troubled Wyoming data center project to Google, highlighting infrastructure challenges in AI development. The deal underscores the massive capital requirements and complexities of building AI-focused facilities.

cards.title: Chinese Spy Allegedly Targeted Nvidia CEO
cards.body: A U.S. intelligence memo reportedly detailed China's Ministry of State Security recruiting a female tech executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO. The incident highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions around AI leadership.

cards.title: Artex AI Hacking Tools Exposed Publicly
cards.body: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting Artex penetration testing tools exposed to the internet. The exposure allowed unrestricted access to the hacking tool, raising security concerns.

cards.title: Voters Restrict Data Centers in Midterms
cards.body: In 41 ballot measures, voters overwhelmingly opposed data center development, with all but one passing restrictions. The results signal growing public resistance to AI infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: AI Spending Stalls Despite Rising Usage
cards.body: Ramp data shows AI usage climbing while spending has plateaued, challenged by price cuts and cost controls among major spenders. The trend could reshape investor assumptions about AI market hypergrowth.

cards.title: Amazon Enables Text Commands for Alexa Shopping
cards.body: Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help with shopping after previously blocking Muse integration. The feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

cards.title: Underdog Demos 32MB Speech Generation Model
cards.body: Despite its tiny size, Underdog's new model generates both speech and music with impressive capabilities. The breakthrough challenges assumptions about model size requirements.

cards.title: Physicl Raises $10M for Robot Simulation Tech
cards.body: Physicl secured $10 million to bridge the sim-to-real gap using an online marketplace pipeline. The technology helps robots understand and interact with the physical world.

cards.title: Palo Alto Networks Acquires Clutch for $500M
cards.body: Palo Alto Networks is in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500 million. Clutch was previously valued at $85 million with backing from Lightspeed and SignalFire.

cards.title: Airbnb Plans AI Travel Agent for 2027
cards.body: Airbnb will launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 to help plan trips and manage bookings. The agent will provide assistance throughout travelers' stays.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Avatar Adds Video Chat Feature
cards.body: Meta users can now video chat with customizable animated Muse AI avatars, expanding agent capabilities. The feature precedes a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed for Muse interaction.

cards.title: Meta Warns Data Center Opposition Threatens AI
cards.body: Meta cautions that growing political opposition to data centers could impede future AI expansion. Communities are increasingly pushing back against massive infrastructure projects.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases New Cybersecurity Model
cards.body: OpenAI launched a new cybersecurity model amid industry scrutiny of AI labs' infrastructure protection efforts. The release addresses growing concerns about AI security vulnerabilities.

cards.title: OpenAI President Says IPO Ready by 2027
cards.body: Greg Brockman stated OpenAI could be IPO-ready in 2027 while touting enterprise market gains. The company is closing ground on rival Anthropic in the business sector.

cards.title: Claude Adds Personal Finance Analysis Tool
cards.body: Claude's new Personal Finance tool lets users connect bank and card accounts via Plaid to analyze spending. Users can now ask questions about their financial data directly.

cards.title: Axiom Math Formally Verifies Stacks Project
cards.body: Axiom Math's AI agents formally verified the Stacks Project, one of mathematics' largest proof libraries. The startup aims to prevent unverified AI-generated mathematical proofs.

cards.title: Elon Musk Faces Rocky Post-Midterm Prospects
cards.body: Midterm election results create uncertainty for Elon Musk's data center and AI infrastructure plans. Political shifts could complicate expansion timelines and regulatory pathways.

cards.title: AI Industry Eyes Challenging Two Years Ahead
cards.body: Democratic midterm victories could reshape the AI industry through stricter data center regulations. Political headwinds may slow AI infrastructure development nationwide.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Cleaning Service Launches in San Francisco
cards.body: A new humanoid robot cleaning service is now operating in San Francisco, offering a glimpse into the future of domestic automation. The technology demonstrates practical AI applications beyond data centers and software.

cards.title: Texas AI Data Center Boom at Risk After Elections
cards.body: Texas has been the fastest-growing data center market for major AI buildouts, but recent political shifts could jeopardize this position. The state's changing leadership may impact Big Tech's infrastructure expansion plans.

cards.title: Reverse Game Theory Could Control Powerful AI Agents
cards.body: A new approach called "reverse game theory" aims to keep powerful AI models in check through strategic design. The technique addresses growing concerns about controlling autonomous AI agents.

cards.title: Securing Enterprise AI Agents Through Data Lineage
cards.body: New security protocols focus on tracking data sources used by AI agents to prevent misinformation in enterprise settings. The approach ensures agents pull from reliable, approved data systems.

cards.title: Nvidia CEO Summoned by Congress Over Espionage Concerns
cards.body: Congress has called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify regarding potential Chinese espionage concerns. The hearing reflects growing scrutiny of AI chip manufacturers and national security.
